reviews.author: Gorilla
reviews.text:
The 100-meter-long street street in the middle of Myeong-dong, Seoul, was reminiscent of a ‘night market.’
Foreign tourists from various countries, including Asian countries such as Taiwan and Singapore, as well as Western countries such as Europe and the United States, were enjoying Korea's unique street food such as chicken skewers, sundae skewers, and dumplings.
Myeong-dong, which seemed to have been bombed by the impact of COVID-19 and was filled with empty stores in alleys, is regaining vitality.
Quarantine measures, such as the end of social distancing and the lifting of pre-entry genetic amplification (PCR) testing, are being lifted quickly, and the significant decline in the value of the won due to the strong dollar is the background for the return of foreigners to Myeong-dong.
Although there are concerns about an economic downturn due to high inflation and high interest rates, Myeong-dong is regaining its pre-COVID-19 appearance as foreign tourists continue to visit.
The number of people from the MZ generation (born between the early 1980s and early 2000s) visiting Myeongdong has also increased significantly.

reviews.author: Seoyoung Lee
reviews.text:
I like massage, so I've been looking for massage shops all over the place, but this massage shop keeps coming back to me, so I keep coming back to this magical massage shop.

Once you enter the store, you will be captivated by the bright, comfortable and clean atmosphere of the store, and the owner and employees will welcome you with a smile.

The interior of the shop is neat and tidy, and the massage gowns, blankets, and towels are made of good materials, have a nice scent, and have a soft texture that makes you feel good when they touch your skin.

Also, the owner checks your skin condition and gives you a massage according to the situation, so after receiving the massage, the facial swelling goes down and the facial structure is revived. Also, if you get a full body massage, you will feel cool and comfortable and the fatigue of the day will disappear.

I recommend going here again rather than going anywhere else.
